entry.title: Membership Inference for Time Series Foundation Models via Forecast Residuals
entry.summary: We study membership inference attacks against time series foundation models using forecast residuals and show that data contamination inflates zero-shot benchmark scores.

entry.title: A Calibrated Score for Pretraining Data Detection in Large Language Models
entry.summary: We propose a new pretraining data detection method for large language models based on calibrated token probabilities, improving over Min-K% on WikiMIA.

entry.title: Efficient Long-Horizon Time Series Forecasting with Sparse Attention
entry.summary: We propose a new attention mechanism for long-horizon forecasting and evaluate it on standard benchmarks.
